mapper.select: select f.user_id userId,count(distinct f.follow_user_id) `match`,count(distinct bf.user_id) `count` from corgi_user_follow f left join corgi_user_follow bf on bf.follow_user_id = f.user_id where f.uptime >= #{date} and f.is_deleted = '0' and bf.is_deleted = '0' group by f.user_id having `count` > 20 order by `match` desc limit #{limit}

select count(1) `match`, user_id userId from ( (select user_id from corgi_activity_comment where ctime >= #{date}) union all (select user_id from corgi_activity_like where ctime >= #{date}) )a group by user_id order by `match` desc limit #{limit}

select b.user_id userId, p.lat lat, p.lng lng, p.uptime `time`, p.locate_type locateType, d.nickname `nickname`, d.avatar avatar, d.avatar_status avatarStatus, d.avatar_check_status avatarCheckStatus, d.role role, d.hide_role hideRole, d.group `group`, d.hide_group `hideGroup`, d.hide_prefer_group `hidePreferGroup`, d.con con, d.relation, d.check_status checkStatus, d.weight, d.height, d.birthday, l.im_id imId from corgi_billboard b left join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = b.user_id left join corgi_user_position p on p.user_id = b.user_id left join corgi_user_login l on l.id = b.user_id where b.date = #{date}
select user_id userId from corgi_billboard where `date` >= #{date}
select b1.user_id userId,count(1) count from corgi_billboard b1 left join corgi_billboard b2 on b1.user_id = b2.user_id where b1.`date` >= #{date} group by b1.user_id having count > 2
select user_id from corgi_user_detail where nickname = #{nickname} limit 1

select b.user_id userId, d.nickname `nickname`, d.avatar avatar, b.date, (select count(1) from corgi_billboard b2 where b2.user_id = b.user_id) count from corgi_billboard b left join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = b.user_id where b.date >= #{startDate} and b.date <= #{endDate}
